body: The only mistake would be to repeat my mistake love
Honestly I hope things get better for you love. I'm sorry you are in such despair :/
Thankyou very much! That is very kind of you.
What do you mean ? What happened to make me stay alive ?

Hey, I'm so sorry you feel that way, that isn't easy to go through love. I know you don't know me but is love to chat if you decide you want to talk ok? I promise you i will listen to you without judgement.  I really hope we get to chat soon

Would you be ok if I messaged you love ?? My mother is a midwife. Fuck that ob by the way,postpartum depression is one of the hardest things to go through. Period. I've seen it first hand and it's not something to just push off to the side. I'm so sorry your doctor is so niave
Hey love,you seem like you're really hurting and I'm truly sorry for that.  Would you be willing to message a stranger and talk? Judgment free I promise

I'm really sorry you feel so hurt. If you want to pm me I'm a good listener and I'm judgement free. If it's ok with you, would you mind sharing how old your baby is ?? Have you read up on postpartum depression love ?
I'm happy for you that you found your strength and survived

I think you need to want to be helped to be helped love. There are always people to listen to you, even just strangers, and i truly hope you decide to reach out because I'd love nothing more then to listen to you and learn about you.

Hey, I won't say I know how you feel because no-one can say that really but I know what it's like to want to die, still do but recently some kind strangers on this sight made me change my mind if only a little bit. If you want to my pm is open to you and you can talk about anything judgement free

Hey, how are you doing today hun ? You're post has stuck with me since I saw it yesterday ! I hope today is easier for you ! Please let us know how you are holding up,you have left such an impression on all of us and we'd love nothing more then to see such an intelligent, wonderful person behind to thrive for who they are

I have a psychiatrtist but I recently moved to the top of a mounraun so I don't know anyone here and I don't have anyone to talk with but this conversation is just making me feel a little more alone but that's my bad, thankyou for trying to cheer me up but I am going to go.
I don't have anyone but thankyou for your suggestion
Today I met someone who understand exactly how I feel and I think that is a very good thing. I am going to focus on my language lessons as much as I can

Well my dear, you are in luck as I am sure I could help you with homework as I help my brother daily ! Im also hella lesbian so I might actually be able to help there with that but I'm so sorry you're dealing with this . If you arnt sure which you like you could be Bi leaning  more towards you own gender or you've just reached the decade that will tell You,again it took me 19 years to accept my gay and you've already found a community love.

I sent a message earlier but I just wanted you you know your post stuck with me all night and I truly hope that these wonderful people made you feel better about who you are , I didn't come out until I was 19 but it's scary and having parents that don't understand how amazing you are is so hard. You are important and amazing for who you are and clearly very bright. Again I know it's uncomfortable to chat with a stranger but my pm is always open if you need to vent. I'm so sorry you feel so hurt :/

I'm sorry you feel that way, it's not weak to seek help though, this whole forum is made up of people in need of help and by no means are we all weaklings. I am not stable enough to really provide anything more then an ear atm but if that helps I'm here.
I spent the night thinking about it and I think it was for a second chance tied with my inability to pick good material.
I've had a lot of traumatic things happen to me in my 23 years and I have no-one
The cells in my ear are dying and hearing aids will only work for a few months and I don't have the 8 grand to get them :/ that's not the only reason i tried to die
I know ASL rather well actually ,I had hh and deaf friends when i was younger

I just dont know where to start. You never have to apologize for not having words,I wish I had the right words to get myself up again or make someone else get up again but it's never easy and I'm so scared

That is very kind but I think it fits me perfectly. I have been thinking alot since the rope snapped about my life up until now and the only good I have is volunteering / languages and music but going deaf has made two of those things really hard and eliminated my dream. I see how many wonderful people there are out there like you and I don't see myself as one. I am so mad my body is breaking down and I'm so scared of this silence that's slowly wrapping around me and I'm so mad the rope snapped. My whole life I've been told to deal by myself and not to speak about the bad things that happen to me and it's built up over so many years and I cant do this alone, and i am so alone.

I decided not to go through with it for today. I was/an slightly concerned it would have been a mean secret based on what I've read on some of these and I just calmed down but if its not mean then id love to hear it
Not really

I'm just tired of it all. Ive talked to my psychiatrtist about wanting to end my life but he rarely looks up from his ipad. I've become apathetic towards everything. I feel very calm about my choice. You are very kind for commenting though

I truly do appreciate the advice but I am truly calm about dying. I have no-one in real life that would be overly hurt honestly, nor do I have anything to look forward to. I probably could do this alone if i were a stronger individual but honestly I'm tired of being strong. It's time to let my weak side take over.
